independentVerification.scope: Independent PE extraction, complete body instruction boundaries, native table-derived valid sets; exhaustive width/status/edge classes and signed relative targets. No native VM execution.

actualProductSourceProbe.scope: Actual linked BdxInspection.cs in isolated process; Asset IO stub never called.

rootRetailRun.scope: Two selected original HED/PKG payloads equal loose slices; all 4480 PCs, widths and normalized edges agree. Root-provided run, not game execution.

analysis: Reviewed all16 opcode groups and native selector defaults, not only artifact hashes. Integer unary1 and float unary0/3/4 are invalid; integer binary sub>11 remains nonterminal.
Signed PC field is loaded with MOVSXD; relative16 uses MOVSX and relative32 is two unsigned words merged before DWORD addition. File offset uses signed PC widened in the reader.
PC0 terminates event lookup regardless of ID. Duplicate ID uses first match. Invalid first entry is not replaced by a later duplicate.
Normal continuation for unsupported address push differs from NULL load/store; group2 selector3 retains native scratch. Both prototype and C# distinguish these cases.
Native call bank=word>>6 and unsigned16 index use16-byte descriptors. Independently verified original bank2 pointer at7534A0 ->756B60 and indices9/95 plus counts3/2 and no return-value bit.
Conditional branch alternatives, call continuations, yields and trap continuations remain conditional. Return has a dynamic boundary without sequential fallthrough.

Bounds, header exclusion, overlap detection, visited identities, output/diagnostic limits and cancellation are appropriate for the C# offline reader. Unvisited bytes are not searched for trap-like words.
Selected event0 witnesses and their immediate IDs are meaningful static paths. No Event27 runtime witness or valid operand0 Actor provenance is claimed.
limits: The exhaustive oracle covers every16-bit opcode with one selected operand pair FFFE/8000; it does not enumerate every operand value or native VM state. Target sign/width extremes are also covered by authored synthetic tests, which were reviewed.

This review never executes the original VM or script. Native callbacks, tag validity, stack bounds, memory side effects, exceptions, compatibility patches and self-modification remain outside CFG proof.
Root product UI and AssetArchiveReader implementation were not covered by this decoder-specific receipt. Probe links exact production BdxInspection.cs; Asset IO stubs are never invoked.
Prototype and C# deliberately differ in invalid-event policy, resource limits and representation of null terminal edges; these differences are documented.
Global trap-table mutability is not removed by original image pointer verification.
